name: Corrupted Blood marks only Humanoid and Beast victims of Taldaram's Torment (#2357)
contract: Corrupted Blood 704692 reads 'When you use Taldaram's Torment on a Humanoid or Beast it now corrupts their blood, increasing your damage dealt against them by $532623s1%'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Corrupted Blood 532623 (MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER, BasePoints 9 -> +10%, EffectSpellClassMask (6291456, 0, 0) = Veinburst plus Reave, TargetA 6). Spell.dbc gives 704692 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and the debuff never landed. The creature-type gate has no spell_proc column and is expressed with CONDITION_SOURCE_TYPE_SPELL_PROC rows, so the scenario needs both sides: Defias Thug 38 has creature_template.type 7 (Humanoid) and must receive the debuff, while the standard Harvest Golem 36 has type 9 (Mechanical) and must not. Taldaram's Torment is cast as 800772 itself.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Corrupted Blood passive is active
DISCRIMINATING: a Humanoid target gains Corrupted Blood 532623
Corrupted Blood grants the DBC value of +10% damage from the caster
Let the second cast finish and any proc resolve
The Mechanical target is left uncorrupted by the creature-type gate
